attempts.summary: Configured sudo on node1 to log every sudo invocation (user, timestamp, full command, TSID) to /var/log/sudo-commands.log via a dedicated sudoers Defaults logfile directive with `!syslog` set, so entries are excluded from the journal/syslog and /var/log/secure. Verified logging works, survives a full node restart, and boot identity changed confirming a real reboot occurred with recovered functionality.
